Q: What is morning serial?

A: Morning serial is a subverse where writers from throughout the internet can come and post their serial fiction a part at a time at the interval they see fit. We do ask that the shortest interval be one week but the longest can be years if your busy with other projects. Every week a top story will be chosen by the community and the writer of that story will get a $25 USD gift card to any major retail location they choose. This isn't a contest, but the top prize is meant as an incentive for writers to participate. The incentive may go up later or expand to include more than a single story.

Q: What is serial fiction?

A: In literature, a serial is a printed format by which a single larger work, often a work of narrative fiction, is published in sequential installments. The installments are also known as numbers, parts, or fascicles, and are either issued as separate publications or within in sequential issues of a single periodical publication.
